title: Questions 151-152 refer to the following e-mail.
passage_1:
To:Riverside Drama Club Members
From:Adaeze Okonjo
Date:February 6
Subject:Notice

Dear Club Members,

I am writing to inform you that the rehearsal arranged for Thursday, February 12, has been postponed. The ventilation system in the community hall is being replaced at the moment, and the building supervisor has told me that the work will not be completed until the middle of next week.

For that reason, we will hold our next meeting on Thursday, February 19. Although I know you are all interested in gathering, this will give you additional time to learn Mr. Halvorsen’s demanding manuscript.

Thank you for being patient, and I look forward to hearing your performances soon.

Best regards,

Adaeze Okonjo
Club Director
